name: ableton-project-manager
title: Ableton Project Manager
description: Browse, organize, and listen to your Ableton Live projects
author: iyek

preferences.name: projectsFolder
preferences.title: Projects Folder
preferences.description: The folder containing your Ableton Live projects.

preferences.name: bouncesFolderName
preferences.title: Bounces Subfolder
preferences.description: The subfolder inside each project where bounces are saved (e.g. Bounces). Leave empty to look directly in each project folder.

preferences.name: notesFolder
preferences.title: Notes Folder
preferences.description: The folder where notes are saved as .md files (e.g. an Obsidian vault). Leave empty to save Notes.md in each project folder.

preferences.name: lyricsFolder
preferences.title: Lyrics Folder
preferences.description: The folder where lyrics are saved as .md files. Leave empty to save Lyrics.md in each project folder.

preferences.name: notesTemplateFile
preferences.title: Notes Template
preferences.description: Optional .md file used as the starting point for new notes. Supports {{title}}, {{date}}, and {{time}}.

preferences.name: lyricsTemplateFile
preferences.title: Lyrics Template
preferences.description: Optional .md file used as the starting point for new lyrics. Supports {{title}}, {{date}}, and {{time}}.

preferences.name: strictLineBreaks
preferences.title: Strict Line Breaks
preferences.label: Strict line breaks
preferences.description: Off: preserve single line breaks. On: follow standard Markdown line breaks (two trailing spaces or a blank line). Affects the preview only; your files aren’t changed.

preferences.name: weightCrest
preferences.title: Energy: Density
preferences.description: How much density (crest factor) affects the energy score. Only the ratio between the three weights matters.

preferences.name: weightBrightness
preferences.title: Energy: Brightness
preferences.description: How much brightness (spectral centroid) affects the energy score.

preferences.name: weightActivity
preferences.title: Energy: Movement
preferences.description: How much movement (spectral flux) affects the energy score.

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.description: Search, play, and organize your Ableton Live projects and collections
commands.subtitle: Ableton Live

commands.name: manage-categories
commands.title: Manage Tags
commands.description: Create and manage Stages, Genres, and Track Roles
commands.subtitle: Ableton Live

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
